name: guard
description: Blocks destructive shell commands and access to secret files before they run, anywhere in a compound command

destructive.title: Block destructive commands
destructive.description: rm -rf on dangerous targets, git push --force, git reset --hard, git clean -f, chmod -R 777, mkfs, dd to devices, curl | sh

rmMode.title: rm -rf
rmMode.description: dangerous: block rm -rf only on roots, homes, the project itself and bare variables; any: block every rm -rf

secrets.title: Protect secret files
secrets.description: .env*, keys, certificates, .npmrc, cloud credentials (Read, Edit, Write, Grep and shell commands that read or copy them)

blockCommands.title: Blocked command patterns
blockCommands.description: Extra regular expressions tested against every Bash command

protectPaths.title: Protected paths
protectPaths.description: Extra globs (gitignore-like) no tool may read or write, e.g. migrations/** or *.lock

allowPaths.title: Allowed paths
allowPaths.description: Globs exempt from the secret-file and protected-path rules, e.g. test/fixtures/.env
